correctness.rationale: Odd-degree character independence gives a connected one-point degree-four cover with genus 3(M−1)/2. Exact alpha-twisted elimination yields w²+w=y+lambda x^D; strict M/2<D<M forces pole orders of w and the correction u without cancellation. Semigroup Apéry gaps exactly equal the curve genus, proving equality. The one-point Cartier formula gives a numbers, and direct floor counts prove the unbounded ray. Finite checker independently tests hundreds of pairs; proof is general, not experimental.

value.rationale: Complete semigroup and Cartier a-number classification for a natural two-exponent family, with an unbounded arithmetic family of jumps in a global Jacobian invariant despite identical quadratic-character conductors and quotient genera. This separates full fiber-product Cartier data from ramification-only descriptions and generalizes an isolated published genus-six phenomenon into an infinite unbounded geometric behavior.
